tailoring.headline: Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud | Senior SAP Commerce Developer & Techno-Functional Analyst
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with over 5 years of experience delivering SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) solutions for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong expertise in Java, Spring, REST/OCC APIs, and end-to-end integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven techno-functional consulting skills: analysing business requirements, writing user stories, designing data flows and supporting production. Experienced in CI/CD, cloud deployments, agile teams and AI-assisted development.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Busch Vacuum Solutions' commitment to digital transformation in the vacuum technology sector. With more than five years of hands-on SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I can immediately contribute to your e-commerce and CX initiatives.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: At Rockwell Automation I designed and implemented end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, covering product catalog, pricing and checkout, ensuring a stable platform for global e-commerce.

bullets.label: Techno-Functional Consulting
bullets.text: I acted as a bridge between business and IT, analysing requirements, writing user stories and functional specs, and delivering integrations with SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee, directly supporting international stakeholders.

bullets.label: Integration & API Management
bullets.text: Built and maintained OCC REST APIs and data pipelines that synchronized product data across PIM, ERP and MDM systems, and led API migrations that improved data consistency.

bullets.label: Project & Release Management
bullets.text: Co-ordinated release cycles via CI/CD pipelines on SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), handled incident, change and release management, and mentored junior developers in agile Scrum teams.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, holds a valid German residence and work permit, serving notice until 15 December 2026 and available from 16 December 2026. Open to remote, hybrid or on-site work.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud (m/w/d)
cover_de.hook: Die Innovationskraft von Busch Vacuum Solutions im Bereich Vakuum-Technologie begeistert mich. Mit über fünf Jahren Praxis in SAP Commerce Cloud bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich das nötige Know-how für Ihre digitale Vertriebs- und Service-Strategie mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Bei Rockwell Automation habe ich SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) von der Konzeption bis zur Implementierung für Produktkatalog, Preisgestaltung und Checkout entwickelt und damit eine stabile globale E-Commerce-Plattform geschaffen.

bullets.label: Techno-funktionale Beratung
bullets.text: Ich habe als Bindeglied zwischen Fachbereichen und IT Geschäftsanforderungen analysiert, User Stories und Funktionsspezifikationen erstellt und Integrationen zu SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee realisiert – stets im internationalen Umfeld.

bullets.label: Integration & API-Management
bullets.text: Entwicklung und Betrieb von OCC-REST-APIs sowie datengetriebenen Pipelines zur Synchronisation von PIM, ERP und MDM, inklusive API-Migrationen zur Steigerung der Datenkonsistenz.

bullets.label: Projekt- und Release-Management
bullets.text: Koordination von Release-Zyklen über CI/CD-Pipelines im SAP Commerce Cloud Portal (CCv2), Verantwortung für Incident-, Change- und Release-Management sowie Mentoring von Junior-Entwicklern im agilen Scrum-Team.

cover_de.logistics: Ich wohne in Karlsruhe, besitze eine uneingeschränkte Arbeitserlaubnis für Deutschland, befinde mich bis zum 15.12.2026 in der Kündigungsfrist und stehe ab dem 16.12.2026 zur Verfügung. Remote, Hybrid oder Vor Ort – flexibel einsetzbar.

tailoring.why_company: Busch Vacuum Solutions combines cutting-edge vacuum technology with a clear vision for digital customer experiences. Your focus on expanding e-commerce capabilities and integrating SAP-CX-Lösungen aligns perfectly with my background in SAP Commerce Cloud, API-driven integrations and international project delivery. I am eager to help accelerate your CX roadmap and support global roll-outs.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise to drive innovative e-commerce solutions for Busch Vacuum Solutions, supporting its digital growth and global customer experience.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell. I’m excited about the Inhouse Consultant role at Busch Vacuum Solutions and would love to discuss how I can add value.
tailoring.email_subject: Application – Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Inhouse Consultant SAP Commerce Cloud position at Busch Vacuum Solutions. I bring over five years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience, strong integration skills and a proven techno-functional consulting background. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss my fit for your team.
